deficiencies.title: Guardrail gap — Level 28 east edge
deficiencies.description: A section of guardrail is missing on Level 28 east edge after yesterday’s deck pour. Temporary edge protection is required before stripping or other trade access in that bay.
bullets: Barricade the bay until rails are restored
Photograph completed rails and close the deficiency

deficiencies.title: Vibrator V-08 cord damage
deficiencies.description: Concrete Vibrator V-08 was tagged out after cord sheathing damage found during pre-use inspection. Unit must not return to service until the cord is replaced and re-inspected.
bullets: Keep V-08 tagged out of service
Use V-04 or V-12 as replacements
Log re-inspection before returning to site

deficiencies.title: Missing tag on Peri panel stack
deficiencies.description: A Peri panel stack in the Burnaby laydown is missing its load/status tag. Untagged stacks create confusion for hops and may hide damaged panels.
bullets: Apply status tag before next hop
Notify yard if panels need return

deficiencies.title: Outrigger pad soft ground — MC-4
deficiencies.description: Mobile Crane MC-4 outrigger pads are set on soft ground near the yard gate. Pads must be relocated to compacted / timbered bearing before any further lifts.
bullets: Stop lifts until pads are reset

correctiveActions.title: Install temporary edge protection Level 28
correctiveActions.description: Corrective action linked to the Level 28 east edge guardrail gap. Temporary rails or covers must be installed and verified before crew re-entry.
bullets: Verify fall protection controls on FLHA

correctiveActions.title: Replace V-08 power cord and re-inspect
correctiveActions.description: Replace the damaged power cord on Concrete Vibrator V-08, complete electrical / pre-use inspection, and clear the out-of-service tag.

correctiveActions.title: Toolbox talk — blind lift radio protocol
correctiveActions.description: Deliver today’s toolbox talk on blind lift radio protocol and collect crew acknowledgements before first lift.
bullets: Review SJP with Crew B / C

correctiveActions.title: Reset MC-4 outrigger pads on timber mats
correctiveActions.description: Relocate Mobile Crane MC-4 outriggers onto adequate bearing and re-verify level before resuming yard lifts.

correctiveActions.title: Tag Peri panel stack — Burnaby laydown
correctiveActions.description: Inspect and tag the untagged Peri panel stack so hop crews know status and condition.

correctiveActions.title: Complete pending FLHA supervisor reviews
correctiveActions.description: Three FLHAs from yesterday remain without supervisor acknowledgement. Review and sign before morning starts.

correctiveActions.title: Schedule Site Orientation for non-compliant labourers
correctiveActions.description: COR worker compliance shows labourers missing Site Orientation. Schedule orientation before assigning elevated work.

weatherAlerts.title: Wind advisory — Burnaby Central
weatherAlerts.body: Gusts forecast 45–55 km/h after 14:00. Review panel flying limits.
weatherAlerts.description: Environment Canada forecasts southwest gusts of 45–55 km/h at Burnaby Central after 14:00. Suspend non-essential crane and panel lifts if wind exceeds site / OEM limits.
bullets: Check crane wind chart before lifts
Hold stop-work toolbox if limits hit

upcomingInspections.title: TC-1 monthly structural
upcomingInspections.description: Monthly structural inspection for Tower Crane TC-1 at Oceanview Tower. Operator daily logs must be available for the inspector.
bullets: Clear swing radius for inspector access
Hold non-essential lifts during inspection window

upcomingInspections.title: MEWP-32-01 annual
upcomingInspections.description: Annual certification inspection for MEWP Scissor 32ft (MEWP-32-01). Unit will be out of service during the inspection window.
bullets: Do not assign MEWP-32-01 on Aug 5
Return tagged unit only after pass

upcomingInspections.title: Fall protection gear audit
upcomingInspections.description: Site audit of harnesses, lanyards, and SRLs assigned to Oceanview crews. Damaged gear will be tagged out immediately.
bullets: Bring all personal fall gear to muster
Log replacements in COR training notes

upcomingInspections.title: Generator G-12 weekly
upcomingInspections.description: Weekly running inspection for site generator G-12 including cords, grounding, and fuel storage.

upcomingInspections.title: Forklift pre-shift series
upcomingInspections.description: Pre-shift inspection series for yard forklift before material staging for Oceanview and Burnaby deliveries.
